messages:
sarah: Heads-up — I just noticed a bunch of OIDC token exchange logs in staging that include full service-account emails and a handful of long-lived refresh tokens. Looks like a logging config from the new auth-proxy wasn't scrubbed. Not public internet but still scoped creds. Trying to triage now.

alex: ack. any PII or customer data exposed or just creds/metadata?

sarah: only service-account emails + tokens. No user PII. Tokens appear to be for an internal ingestion svc (ingest-oidc). TTLs look long — some issued ~3 months ago.

irene: @sarah thanks for catching. that sounds like a vault->oidc integration misconfig where the audit logger captured response bodies. We should treat as credential leakage. Proposed immediate actions: 1) rotate the SA and revoke any tokens; 2) rotate Vault wrapping key used for that role; 3) tighten RBAC on auth-proxy logs; 4) run brief vuln triage for other services.

mike: I'm on patching RBAC and logs. I'll push a deny rule to the logging pipeline to drop request/response bodies for auth-proxy.

alex: i can do the SA key rotation and token revoke. action plan? timeline?

irene: plan (short):
- T+0 (now): mark impacted creds as compromised — create incident tag and add to incidents slack channel. set read-only alert on any use of ingest-oidc SA.
- T+10m: revoke all existing SA keys + force re-issue. Alex please coordinate.
- T+30m: rotate Vault wrapping key and update Vault role mapping for OIDC. Sarah/Mike to coordinate with ops.
- T+60m: confirm logging pipeline scrub deployed and roll out RBAC restriction (deny log body).
- T+120m: validate no more token exchanges leaking and run short artifact scan across recent logs for similar patterns.

sarah: I'll start scanning last 48h of logs for the pattern and enumerate which environments and jobs wrote the bodies. sharing snippet: 
```
regex: ("service_account_email"\s*:\s*"[\w-]+@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com")
```

mike: pushing scrub rule now. pipeline change: add redact step before sink: `logp.add_filter(redact_response_bodies=True)` — will rollout to staging first.

alex: rotating keys now. steps I'm doing: 1) `gcloud iam service-accounts keys list --iam-account=ingest-oidc@...` 2) create new key and upload to Vault at secret/ingest/sa-key/new 3) update deployment secrets and restart pods 4) revoke old keys with `gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete`. Will post key IDs.

deploy-bot: Deploy started by alex: logging-pipeline/redact-rule v2 -> staging

irene: For Vault/KMS: when rotating the Vault wrapping key, ensure KMS key version used for wrapping is rotated and old wrapped ciphertexts are rewrapped or evicted. Also update audit logging to record wrap/unwrap events for the role.

sarah: quick Q: do we want to immediately rewrap all existing secrets encrypted with the old wrapping key? that could be disruptive. alternative is to create new wrapping key version and allow old ciphertexts to unwrap until TTL, but that leaves attack window. thoughts?

irene: prefer creating a new KMS key version and schedule rewrap for secrets used by production services only first. do a staggered rewrap: critical services now, lower-risk later. Document the rewrap window in the incident ticket.

mike: scrub rule pushed to staging, looks good. will promote to prod after 10m monitoring. added log metric to detect any resp bodies >1kb for auth-proxy.

alex: new SA key created: key-id=AKIA... (posted to incident ticket). rolling updates to ingest pods in progress. Old keys queued for deletion in 15m after verifying no restarts fail.

sarah: found 7 jobs that emitted full response bodies (k8s job names). I'll paste list to the incident ticket and file PRs to remove debug logging.

irene: solid. assign owners: alex = SA rotation and revoke, mike = logging pipeline redaction + RBAC rule, sarah = log scan + remediation PRs, irene = Vault/KMS rewrap plan + audit update. Anyone else needed?

mike: added RBAC deny for logging write access to auth-proxy logs for non-ops teams.

alex: revoke done for 2 stale keys. one remaining key in use by a stuck job — I'll patch job image to use new key and then revoke.

deploy-bot: Deploy finished: logging-pipeline/redact-rule v2 -> staging (success)

sarah: quick recap and next steps: we have redaction in staging, SA key rotation underway, Vault/KMS rotation plan drafted. I'll run the 48h pattern scan and post results in 30m.

irene: thanks team. after we finish, we'll file an RCA/mitigation doc and add the logging scrub to the standard security baseline checklist. :lock:

mike: monitoring for any resp-body metric spikes. ping me if you see suspicious reauths.

alex: one more note — we should add an automatic linter in CI to fail builds that enable request/response body logging for any service under `auth/` or `ingest/`. filing issue now.

sarah: noted. filing PR to add lint rule and a short eval to search for `response_body` in repo. thanks all.
